title: Ibrance (palbociclib) Pivotal Trial Efficacy and Neutropenia Data: Reading the Charts

questions.caption: Median investigator-assessed PFS in PALOMA-2, a phase 3 trial of palbociclib+letrozole vs placebo+letrozole in postmenopausal women with previously untreated HR+/HER2- advanced breast cancer (NEJM primary analysis).
questions.prompt: Based on the PALOMA-2 primary PFS analysis shown, what is the absolute difference in median PFS between the two arms?
questions.rationale: The chart shows median PFS of 24.8 months with palbociclib+letrozole versus 14.5 months with placebo+letrozole in the PALOMA-2 primary analysis, an absolute difference of 10.3 months (24.8 - 14.5).

citations.title: Palbociclib and Letrozole in Advanced Breast Cancer | NEJM

questions.caption: Final overall survival (secondary endpoint) in PALOMA-2 at 90-month median follow-up, palbociclib+letrozole vs placebo+letrozole in first-line HR+/HER2- advanced breast cancer.
questions.prompt: Reading the PALOMA-2 final overall survival medians shown, which statement correctly characterizes the result?

options.a: Median OS was numerically longer with palbociclib+letrozole (53.9 vs 51.2 months), a difference that was not statistically significant (HR 0.956)
options.b: Median OS was significantly longer with palbociclib+letrozole, confirming a survival benefit
options.c: Median OS was shorter with palbociclib+letrozole than with letrozole alone
options.d: The chart shows a 10.3-month OS advantage for palbociclib+letrozole, matching the PFS benefit

questions.rationale: The chart shows 53.9 vs 51.2 months (a 2.7-month numerical difference), and the reported hazard ratio was 0.956 (95% CI 0.777-1.177), which was not statistically significant per the final PALOMA-2 OS analysis; option d incorrectly imports the PFS difference from a different endpoint.

questions.caption: Median PFS in PALOMA-3, a phase 3 trial of palbociclib+fulvestrant vs placebo+fulvestrant in HR+/HER2- advanced breast cancer with prior progression on endocrine therapy (FDA approval review basis).
questions.prompt: According to the pivotal PALOMA-3 PFS data that supported FDA approval, how much longer was median PFS with palbociclib+fulvestrant compared with placebo+fulvestrant?
questions.rationale: The chart shows median PFS of 9.5 months with palbociclib+fulvestrant versus 4.6 months with placebo+fulvestrant, an absolute difference of 4.9 months; 9.5 months is the palbociclib arm's own value (not the difference), 6.6 months comes from a later non-prespecified updated analysis not shown here, and 0.46 is the hazard ratio, not a time difference.

questions.caption: Grade 3 and Grade 4 neutropenia incidence in the palbociclib arms of PALOMA-2 (with letrozole) and PALOMA-3 (with fulvestrant).
questions.prompt: Comparing Grade 3 and Grade 4 neutropenia incidence between PALOMA-2 (palbociclib+letrozole) and PALOMA-3 (palbociclib+fulvestrant) as shown, which statement is best supported by the chart?

options.a: Grade 3 neutropenia incidence was similar between trials (~55-56%), while Grade 4 incidence was slightly higher in PALOMA-3 (11%) than PALOMA-2 (10%)
options.b: Grade 4 neutropenia was more than twice as common in PALOMA-3 as in PALOMA-2
options.c: Grade 3 neutropenia was substantially higher in PALOMA-3 than in PALOMA-2
options.d: Neither trial reported Grade 4 neutropenia above 5%

questions.rationale: The chart shows Grade 3 neutropenia at 56% (PALOMA-2) and 55% (PALOMA-3), essentially similar, while Grade 4 neutropenia was 10% (PALOMA-2) versus 11% (PALOMA-3), a small increase rather than a doubling; both trials reported Grade 4 rates well above 5%.
